seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms as freelance couriers in Hallia, taking odd jobs that pull them into a growing conspiracy involving flesh-stealing Ugathul, radar dishes, and the Embercall. After tracing leads through sewers and a necromantic manor beneath the city, they attempt to collect a bounty on the Roundhat Gang's leader — only to suffer a devastating total party kill at the Crowded Flea.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: In the aftermath of the TPK, Johnny and Benny's souls traverse the Black and White void where they meet the entity Aut, who resurrects them at a cost. The rebuilt party — joined by Sir Arctos — hunts down Hlarf for revenge, kills Tywelwyn Leatherhide in his fiery Fane, and uncovers a conspiracy of six outer gods trying to crack the Firmament via radar dishes. They report everything to the Inquisition, only to find their handler Brooks has been abducted.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Rescuing Anaïs reveals the cosmic family called the Narrative — Aut, Renge, and their siblings — reshaping the party's understanding of their place in the cosmos. They attend a mysterious pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, competing in trials and a scavenger hunt for one of twenty keystones that grant passage aboard a colossal Strider. After trading a stolen painting to a sentient train-Heart and surviving an ambush by Concordia enforcers, they secure their keystone — and their dead companion Argyle returns, but only half of him.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During months of downtime, the party investigates sewers beneath Hallia and discovers a hairline fracture in reality itself — a crack in the Firmament where a two-mile-tall imprisoned god looms on the other side. Hacking a research terminal reveals a vast conspiracy to shatter the barrier, funded by Grayson and tied to the Prime Minister. The party bombs the facility, collapsing Teller's Run, but the Harlequin announces the Strider departs in one week — kicking off the next phase of their journey.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party boards the colossal Strider, battles void-entities to forge their own sentient Heart named Eerie, and spends weeks building a coalition of factions to survive the weekly tithe of magical energy. Below decks, they descend into the Undercroft, slay the spider-usurper Vrax'leth, and awaken an ancient Machine God who becomes their ally — all while navigating the Strider's deadly politics and the Master of Ceremonies' promise of organized violence between the nineteen factions.

seasons.title: The End of the Menhir
seasons.arc_summary: The party assaults the Herald's sleeping clan in a pristine hospital deep within the Strider, poisons their corrupted Heart, and discovers the Ashen Pact — six entities overseeing the world. In a fateful ritual to recruit the Menhir as an ally, Argyle accidentally destroys the entire Menhir using a god-killing revolver, triggering catastrophic consequences: the Strider is flung far starward to a dead, scoured world, the Harlequins are wiped out, and the party is stranded off every known map with an angry cosmic family watching.

seasons.title: Stranded
seasons.arc_summary: Stranded on a godless horizon, the party rallies surviving factions, establishes a fragile ceasefire with Grayson, and recruits the freed gunslinger Egan by diving into his mindscape to sever the Herald's hold. They assault the Strider's corrupted spire, pursue Anzu's sister Galzu through surreal memory-vignettes inside a dying Heart's Fane, and explore the tessellated wreckage of an alien mining ship — making first contact with castaways who reveal the Ashen Pact's newly-ascended members and that the Thessians can be killed with the party's golden spikes.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: Three Actinium Convox operatives — Banyan, Giancarlo Santucci, and Crindle Vilksnake — are tasked with deploying the "Midnight Sun" bomb in a Raelion Fane atop a ley line. They infiltrate the city of Orilon via river and sewer, find the bone-tree heart of the Fane, and in a desperate combat activate the monolith just before its countdown completes — obliterating all of Raelion. The session is set 20 years before the main campaign.

seasons.title: The Heist and the Needle
seasons.arc_summary: The party kidnaps Yudan from the Leviathan's bio-organic control system, forges an uneasy alliance to defeat the Feep, and ventures into Oresk's underground where they discover a divine forge and plead their case before the Narrative to craft a godpiercer needle from Holy Gold.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A Die Hard–style holiday one-shot set in Calaria's capital, Halnia. Hildebrandt Corporation employees Atsuki, Mika Buzzle, Vint, and Chris Gangle attend a Bright Souls Eve party at headquarters, only for a terrorist named Naren Rodder to seize the building. After clearing the ballroom of captors and discovering Director of Strategy Vitor Frey is a traitor, the team climbs to the vault floor and engages Naren—who is blessed by the Heir of the Plague—in a desperate fight that ends with the Plague Codex launched out a blown-out wall into the unknown.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: Descent into the Joker World
seasons.arc_summary: The Cagley Middle shadow-demon one-shot concludes as four 8th-graders slay the Terror of Cagley, then a new arc opens with four Scale operatives dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure, descending into a chasm where their divine power wanes and demon swarms attack.

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: The Scale team enters the fiend-built Quorum, solves its gear-and-riddle puzzles, fights through Sigzilheight's forces, descends through a bloodfall portal into a surreal fiend bureaucracy, and rescues Voice of Many — a trapped divine heart and grandchild of the Judge — in a desperate ten-round defense before teleporting to safety.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: A Sedecium fire team is dispatched to investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, where they free a tortured ship AI, rotate the station back into real space, and uncover that the Thessian Esoterica (formerly Gremory) recently accessed observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job
seasons.arc_summary: The same fire team is pulled from retirement for a daring one-shot heist aboard a Sundom planet-killer warship, descending through the Slip to raid the divine essence of the freshly-killed Thessian god Tithe before the God Eater Harrow can finish consuming it — becoming the first and only team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: When a goblin intern at Bisney & Dixar Animated Studios connects a new arcane intelligence to the studio's databases, the AI overloads and casts a spell that engulfs Los Diablos in a blackout and creates a 'movie' on the island of Afro-China. Three Disney villains — Hades, Fulton (Gaston's legally distinct cousin), and Runway Brian (a forgotten Disney short mouse) — are chosen by a mandrill statue of Zeus to recover an enchanted mirror stolen by Maui, now hidden in an Elephant Graveyard of Wonders. After surviving a wildebeest stampede, solving the Cave of Wonders' riddle, defeating the hybrid genie Jaskar (Jafar-Scar fusion), and wishing themselves past a whole skipped sequence to the final soundstage, the trio battles the Legally Distinct Nostalgia Hydra — a five-headed amalgamation of iconic Disney characters that undergoes a terrifying live-action reboot mid-fight. They slay it, seize the mirror, and dive through it into the real world.
